DIAGNOSIS READY: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)

I have reviewed your symptoms, which include progressive weakness, speech difficulties, rigidity, tremors, and orthostatic hypotension. These findings are inconsistent with cellulitis and suggest a neurological disorder affecting both upper and lower motor neurons. The MRI of your cervical spine has returned, please confirm if you saw any reports of spinal cord compression or significant atrophy. Additionally, I need to know if you have experienced any muscle weakness in your arms or hands, as this helps differentiate between various neurodegenerative conditions.
